name: POP-05 daily unrest restart and recovery verification

tests.name: Verify daily loss, stoppage, ownership and population class persisted across restart

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT population=16 AND slave_unrest_stopped AND colonists_ore=8 AND colonists_org=4 AND colonists_eq=2 AND colonists_weapons=2 FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND MAX(applied_population_loss)=4 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int,(SELECT owner_type='player' AND population_type='SLAVE' FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int;

tests.name: Make stoppage deadline expired and retry the failed due planet

data.sql: UPDATE planets SET slave_unrest_stoppage_until=EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint-1,slave_unrest_next_at=CASE WHEN name='v3_pop05_rollback_qa' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint-1 ELSE slave_unrest_next_at END WHERE name IN ('v3_pop05_daily_qa','v3_pop05_rollback_qa');

tests.name: Run scheduler to recover persistent stoppage and apply retried due event
Verify recovery without repeat loss and successful rollback retry

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT population=16 AND NOT slave_unrest_stopped FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int,(SELECT population=16 AND slave_unrest_stopped AND colonists_ore+colonists_org+colonists_eq+colonists_weapons+colonists_unassigned=16 FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_rollback_qa')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND MAX(applied_population_loss)=4 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_pop05_rollback_qa')::int;
DELETE FROM planets WHERE name IN ('v3_pop05_daily_qa','v3_pop05_rollback_qa');
